source.bundle: Local fixed Vue production build from the working tree, not the trusted release image. The temporary same-origin entrypoint only selected the synthetic channel and held history scrollTop at zero; it was restored after capture. Product JavaScript and CSS assets were unchanged by the entrypoint.

fixture.scope: Isolated loopback Go API and WSL PostgreSQL schema, five synthetic accounts, one selected TEXT channel with six Russian messages at the reference times on 19 September 2026, and one metadata-only settings.json attachment. No production account, private message body, physical attachment, or LiveKit media was used.
fixture.browser: Installed Chrome headless with isolated profiles, device scale 1, 10000 ms virtual-time budget and same-origin synthetic cookie login. Cookie and credentials were never placed in URLs, CLI arguments, screenshot artifacts, or this record.
fixture.scroll: Both reference and candidate use the beginning of the six-message history. Candidate scrollTop was forced to zero after asynchronous load so narrow captures did not silently select the bottom.

captures.artifact_policy: All PNGs are synthetic, local-only ignored artifacts; their hashes and measured geometry are recorded here, but no generated media is staged.

comparison.measurement: At desktop x=309 and narrow x=21, contiguous high-brightness runs within the flat-color avatar edge were measured in the reference product crop and the candidate PNG. Values are avatar top y coordinates in product pixels, excluding demo chrome. The first five visible rows have identical fixture text, author order, timestamps, date and scroll position.
comparison.aligned: Desktop conversation-header border is at product y=63 and the first date divider near y=94 in both; x=280/x=1192 shell boundaries remain aligned. The CSS A/B override on the old build first produced the after coordinates; the rebuilt product CSS reproduced both override screenshots byte-for-byte.
comparison.remaining_differences: The sixth desktop row remains 4 px above the reference after the metadata-only attachment. The fixture has different avatar colors, unread/presence state, a synthetic administrator and no connected voice. Whole-image pixel equality is therefore neither calculated nor claimed. The reference has no matching DM screenshot.

change: Only ungrouped adjacent message rows now use an 18 px separation; the first row after a date uses 28 px desktop or 24 px below 1024 px. Grouped-message and non-message list spacing remain on their existing rules.
